name: Linda Christina Morales Whitaker
extra_bullets: Plan the firm's quarterly client events, including venues, catering, invitations and the guest list for up to 150 people
Kept the provider schedules and the on-call list current and shared them with the hospital's answering service each week
Covered the hospital's main switchboard during weekend shifts and paged staff as needed
cover_letter_paragraph: I also keep good notes. Every recurring task I handle has a short written checklist, so anyone covering for me can pick it up without a long handover. My managers have told me this is one of the most useful things I do, especially during vacations and busy seasons.
